page.notes: Much of the page is smudged and blotted, especially the left-column head word, the right-column top line, and several Hebrew vocalised forms. The Hebrew words are read from a poor scan; where I could not read them letter by letter I have marked them with [?] or left them illegible rather than guessing. "affe" in "amarum affe" and "retendit" are as far as I can tell printed that way, but are doubtful. "nostér" is printed with an odd accent. The Hebrew page head "ס ר / ם ר" is uncertain. The "Rad." lines and the "מ ר" letter heading are set as paragraphs, not headings.
